revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a broad factory corridor with safety rails, distant machinery, clean matte concrete industrial floor, and warm practical interior lighting. Front-oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, ample surrounding context to judge body support. Main subject: a tall broad-built adult wearing a reflective work vest over subdued gray and olive neutral work clothing, lying unmistakably horizontal on the ground in a tucked side posture with one limb partly hidden. Scene must look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture. Include a cart near one edge of the frame and ample negative space around the subject. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, artificial annotation, medical staff, ambulances, first-aid equipment, cones, instruction boards, or training signage.
